record.bible_text: And David<WH01732> numbered<WH06485><WTH8799> the people<WH05971> that <FI>were<Fi> with him, and set<WH07760><WTH8799> captains<WH08269> of thousands<WH0505> and captains<WH08269> of hundreds<WH03967> over them.
